objective.endpoint: Mean amplitude in a preregistered latency window
objective.spatial_support: Native intersection of named scalp EEG channels

contract.split_policy: Not predictive; all-data fitting is declared where used
invariants: Preserve event meaning and declared timing precision
Keep native and estimated channels distinguishable

toolchain_decisions.intent: Assess BIDS 1.11.1 conformance and preserve a JSON issue report without changing the source
hard_constraints: Use the official BIDS conformance implementation

candidates.capability: Validate the selected dataset against the pinned BIDS schema and emit JSON issues
candidates.read_scope: Dataset tree, sidecars, and validator-required file headers
candidates.write_scope: Standard output captured to a report outside source_root
candidates.reason: It is the official conformance engine and satisfies the requested machine-readable report

candidates.capability: Index BIDS entities and resolve inherited metadata
candidates.write_scope: No write with an in-memory index
candidates.reason: Useful in the metadata-query phase but not a replacement for the official Validator

toolchain_decisions.fallback_condition: If the pinned executable is unavailable, install or run the documented official Deno release and record its version before validation

harmonization_decisions.decision: Convert documented physical units to volts
harmonization_decisions.rationale: Amplitude comparisons require compatible physical units
harmonization_decisions.validation: Check scale against sidecar units and robust amplitude summaries

harmonization_decisions.decision: Use the native intersection and do not interpolate
harmonization_decisions.rationale: The endpoint remains defined without modeled channels
harmonization_decisions.information_loss: Channels outside the intersection are excluded from cross-dataset summaries
harmonization_decisions.validation: Report retained native support per dataset

qc.notes: Replace template values with executed diagnostics

limitations.issue: Hardware filter model is not fully reported
limitations.affected_inference: Frequencies near the acquisition passband edge may not be comparable
limitations.mitigation: Restrict interpretation to the common documented passband and report uncertainty
